blocks.title: Electrolytic cell
blocks.text: Electrolytic cell woh device (aala, mashine) hai jo electrolysis naam ke process se electrical energy ko chemical energy mein badalta hai.

Is mein do electrodes hote hain, aam taur par metal ya kisi aur conductor (bijli guzarne wali cheez) ke, jo electrolyte mein doobe hote hain. Electrolyte woh substance hai jis mein azad (free) ions hon jo electric current le jate hain.
Jab direct current (DC) lagaya jata hai to ek electrode negative charge wala (cathode) aur doosra positive charge wala (anode) ban jata hai.

Electrolytic cell mein electrolyte ke positive ions cathode ki taraf jate hain aur wahan electrons lete hain (reduction), jabke negative ions anode ki taraf jate hain aur wahan electrons dete hain (oxidation). Ions ki yeh movement (harkat) aur electrons ka transfer electrodes par chemical tabdeeliyan lata hai, yani electrical energy chemical energy mein badal jati hai.

blocks.alt: Electrolytic cell. Beaker mein liquid jis par 'Electrolyte' likha hai, us mein do khare electrodes. Left electrode Anode (positive electrode) aur right Cathode (negative electrode) taaron se oopar ek cell ke nishan se jure hain jis ki anode wali taraf + aur cathode wali taraf - hai; is par 'Direct current power supply' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.1: Electrolytic cell ke basic (bunyadi) hisse (kitab ki Figure 10.1 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Battery ka positive terminal anode se aur negative terminal cathode se jura hai. Is liye negative ions (anions) positive anode ki taraf aur positive ions (cations) negative cathode ki taraf khinchte hain.

Electrolytic cells sodium chloride ki electrolysis se sodium metal aur chlorine gas banane, metals ki refining (safai) aur plating, aur caustic soda jaise chemicals banane mein istemal hote hain. Electrolysis se chlorine jaise non-metals bhi banaye jate hain aur metals saaf kiye jate hain. Electrolysis aam taur par Figure 10.1 jaise electrolysis cell mein ki jati hai.

items: electrolyte woh compound hai jo toot-ta (decompose hota) hai; yeh ya to pighla hua (molten) ionic compound hota hai ya ions ka concentrated aqueous solution
electrodes carbon (graphite) ya metal ke hote hain aur electrolyte tak bijli le jate aur wapas late hain — anode positive electrode aur cathode negative electrode hai
power supply direct current (DC) honi chahiye.

blocks.text: Cell ki asal structure (banawat) is baat par depend karti hai ke kaun sa element nikala ja raha hai.

blocks.prompt: Electrolysis ke liye direct current (DC) kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: DC mein anode hamesha positive aur cathode hamesha negative rehta hai, is liye cations hamesha cathode par aur anions anode par jate hain aur products jama hote hain. AC mein electrodes ka nishan baar baar ulat-ta, to koi product jama na hota.

items: Electrolytic cell: electrical energy → chemical energy (electrolysis).
Cathode negative: cations electrons lete hain (reduction). Anode positive: anions electrons dete hain (oxidation).
Electrolyte molten ya concentrated aqueous; electrodes graphite ya metal; supply DC.
